metadata.title: Programme for Government accountability tracker
metadata.baseline_document: Programme for Government 2025 — Securing Ireland's Future
metadata.status_note: Initial selected commitments, not a complete extraction of all programme pledges. Status refers to publicly verifiable implementation evidence, not political judgement.

status_definitions.in_progress: A relevant implementation action or measurable output is evidenced; this does not mean the final target is on track.
status_definitions.not_verifiable: Available sources do not establish a reliable delivery status against the exact commitment.
status_definitions.delivered: The specified output is complete; outcome effectiveness must still be assessed separately.
status_definitions.delayed: A published milestone or deadline has been missed, supported by evidence.
status_definitions.revised: The Government has formally changed the commitment or target.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Deliver 300,000 new homes by the end of 2030.
starter_rows.source_quote: Ramp up construction capacity to build over 300,000 new homes by the end of 2030.
starter_rows.source_page: Programme for Government 2025, housing section; confirm final PDF page number before citation in a public release.
starter_rows.responsible_department: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
starter_rows.target: 300,000 homes by end-2030; annual trajectory and tenure mix must be extracted from the housing plan.
starter_rows.latest_metric: 38,792 completions in the 12 months to Q3 2026; 10,154 completions in Q3 2026.
starter_rows.budget_allocation: NDP Review 2025 includes approximately €36bn for the Department of Housing to 2030; distinguish departmental capital allocation from total programme cost.
starter_rows.outcome_indicator: Completions by tenure and location; household formation; affordability; rents; homelessness; vacancy; infrastructure readiness.
starter_rows.notes: Completions are rising, but this does not establish whether the cumulative 300,000 target is on trajectory. Need a consistent baseline and annual target path. Homelessness and affordability remain separate outcome tests.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Reduce homelessness and strengthen prevention and support for children and families.
starter_rows.source_quote: Programme commitment on homelessness and housing supports; exact verbatim passage and page to be confirmed against final programme PDF.
starter_rows.source_page: Programme for Government 2025; exact page extraction outstanding.
starter_rows.responsible_department: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage, with relevant health, education and children services
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
starter_rows.target: No single numeric PFG target recorded; evaluate against monthly homelessness series and published action-plan milestones.
starter_rows.deadline: Ongoing; milestones in Aire child and family homelessness action plan
starter_rows.latest_metric: 18,065 people in emergency accommodation in September 2026; a separate November report cited 5,830 children in emergency accommodation.
starter_rows.delivery_evidence_title: Aire — Action Plan on Child and Family Homelessness
starter_rows.budget_allocation: Aire plan announced an additional €20m; verify allocation and outturn separately.
starter_rows.outcome_indicator: Monthly adult and child homelessness; exits to secure housing; repeat homelessness; prevention interventions; family support outcomes.
starter_rows.notes: A plan and funding are implementation actions, not proof of reduced homelessness. Definitions and reporting months differ across cited figures.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Increase hospital bed capacity by approximately 4,000 to 4,500 new and refurbished beds.
starter_rows.source_quote: Commitment reported in the Programme for Government; confirm exact wording and page against official PDF.
starter_rows.source_page: Programme for Government 2025, health section; exact page extraction outstanding.
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
starter_rows.deadline: Programme lifetime; exact phasing and deadline not specified in this tracker
starter_rows.latest_metric: 114,722 people on inpatient/day-case waiting lists and 692,524 on outpatient waiting lists in September 2026.
starter_rows.budget_allocation: NDP includes over €9.2bn for Department of Health capital investment to 2030; this is not a bed-specific allocation.
starter_rows.outcome_indicator: Net staffed beds opened; occupancy; admissions; length of stay; waiting-time bands; cancelled procedures; workforce capacity.
starter_rows.notes: Waiting lists do not measure bed delivery. Need HSE bed census, staffed-bed series and a baseline definition distinguishing new from refurbished beds.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Reduce the primary school pupil-teacher ratio to 19:1 over the lifetime of the Government.
starter_rows.source_quote: Cut the pupil teacher ratio to 19:1 in primary schools over the lifetime of the government.
starter_rows.source_page: Programme for Government 2025, education section; verify exact page.
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
starter_rows.deadline: By end of Government term; exact annual milestones not specified
starter_rows.latest_metric: No verified latest national ratio attached in this register.
starter_rows.latest_metric_period: Awaiting Department of Education annual statistics
starter_rows.delivery_evidence_title: Department of Education — statistics and publications
starter_rows.budget_allocation: Requires annual teacher-pay and school staffing outturn analysis.
starter_rows.outcome_indicator: National and school-level pupil-teacher ratio; class size distribution; teacher vacancies; special education needs provision.
starter_rows.notes: Do not substitute average class size for pupil-teacher ratio; they are different measures.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Extend free GP care to children up to at least age 12.
starter_rows.source_quote: Plan for free GP services to be extended to children up to at least 12 years.
starter_rows.source_page: Programme for Government 2025, health section; verify exact page.
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
starter_rows.target: Free GP care eligibility extended to at least age 12
starter_rows.deadline: Programme lifetime; specific commencement date to be verified
starter_rows.latest_metric: No verified commencement and eligible-population count attached in this register.
starter_rows.latest_metric_period: Awaiting current scheme rules and HSE/Department update
starter_rows.delivery_evidence_title: Department of Health — GP visit card scheme
starter_rows.budget_allocation: Requires annual GP contract and scheme expenditure data.
starter_rows.outcome_indicator: Eligibility age; number of eligible children enrolled; GP capacity; access and utilisation.
starter_rows.notes: Distinguish a policy announcement, a negotiated GP contract, commencement date and actual uptake.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Phase out the means test for the Carer's Allowance over five years.
starter_rows.source_quote: Pledge to phase out the means test for carers over the next five years.
starter_rows.source_page: Programme for Government 2025, social protection section; verify exact page.
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
starter_rows.target: Phased removal of the Carer's Allowance means test
starter_rows.deadline: Five-year programme period, subject to the formal implementation schedule
starter_rows.latest_metric: No verified schedule or completed phase recorded.
starter_rows.latest_metric_period: Awaiting Department of Social Protection implementation update
starter_rows.delivery_evidence_title: Department of Social Protection — Carer's Allowance
starter_rows.budget_allocation: Requires Budget measures, estimated cost and actual recipient/outturn data.
starter_rows.outcome_indicator: Means-test thresholds and rules by year; number of carers newly eligible; payment adequacy; labour supply and poverty effects.
starter_rows.notes: A five-year pledge needs staged milestones. Do not mark delivered based only on a threshold increase.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Achieve a 51% reduction in greenhouse-gas emissions by 2030 and net-zero no later than 2050.
starter_rows.source_quote: Government recommitted to a 51 per cent reduction in emissions by 2030 and net-zero emissions no later than 2050.
starter_rows.source_page: Climate commitments in Programme for Government 2025; exact page to be verified.
starter_rows.responsible_department: Department of Climate, Energy and the Environment
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
starter_rows.target: 51% emissions reduction by 2030 relative to 2018; net-zero no later than 2050.
starter_rows.delivery_evidence_title: EPA — Ireland's greenhouse-gas emissions decrease by 2.2% in 2025
starter_rows.budget_allocation: Link annual climate capital allocations and sectoral programme expenditure; avoid treating total NDP as climate-only spending.
starter_rows.outcome_indicator: Annual and cumulative emissions against carbon budgets; sectoral ceilings; renewable electricity; retrofit delivery; transport and agriculture emissions.
starter_rows.notes: One annual reduction does not establish alignment with the 2030 target. Compare the inventory with carbon budgets and sectoral ceilings; 2025 data are provisional.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Improve public transport capacity and advance major projects including MetroLink, DART+ and BusConnects.
starter_rows.source_quote: Programme contains commitments to major public transport investment and project delivery; project-level wording and pages to be verified.
starter_rows.source_page: Programme for Government 2025, transport section; exact page extraction outstanding.
starter_rows.responsible_department: Department of Transport, National Transport Authority and Transport Infrastructure Ireland
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
starter_rows.target: Project-specific milestones to be taken from approved business cases and sectoral investment plan.
starter_rows.deadline: Multiple project timelines through 2030 and beyond
starter_rows.latest_metric: NDP Review includes €24.3bn for transport 2026–2035; this is an allocation, not completed infrastructure.
starter_rows.budget_allocation: €24.3bn transport allocation in the NDP 2026–2035; project-level allocations and outturn must be separately tracked.
starter_rows.outcome_indicator: Project milestones, cost and schedule variance, passenger capacity, frequency, reliability, journey times, accessibility and emissions.
starter_rows.notes: Funding and approval milestones do not equal operational delivery. Maintain one record per major project in the next iteration.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Advance disability rights, services and inclusion through a whole-of-government programme.
starter_rows.source_quote: Programme and National Human Rights Strategy commitments; exact Programme for Government text and page to be verified.
starter_rows.source_page: Programme for Government 2025 and National Human Rights Strategy for Disabled People 2025–2030.
starter_rows.responsible_department: Department of Children, Disability and Equality, HSE and relevant departments
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
starter_rows.target: Track strategy actions, service access and rights outcomes; no single aggregate target.
starter_rows.latest_metric: No consolidated, current service-access baseline attached.
starter_rows.budget_allocation: Requires disability-service Estimates and actual expenditure, broken down by service.
starter_rows.outcome_indicator: Therapy waiting times, personal assistance hours, residential placements, accessible transport, education supports and independent-living outcomes.
starter_rows.notes: Use disaggregated measures and disabled people's lived experience; expenditure alone is not an outcome.
